completionSentence: 같은 generation의 파일은 OCR·bounded text·document 관측을 로컬 SQLite FTS에서 재사용하고, 파일이 바뀌거나 사라지면 stale 관측을 폐기하며, 모델에는 일치한 최대 240자 근거만 제공한다.
qualified: Cache identity is the exact path plus dev, inode, size, mtime, observation kind and engine version.
A warm image query performs zero native OCR calls when the file generation is unchanged.
A changed or missing file invalidates and removes its stale FTS row before ranking.
Only matched lines enter the bounded candidate excerpt; an unrelated sentinel line remains absent.
The SQLite file and parent directory are local mode 0600 and 0700 and are derived, noncanonical whole-state data.
Cache failure degrades to direct observation and is reported in search coverage instead of blocking the user task.
